% Pattern: head/proof. An environment with no title whose body starts with a
% bold proof head is the proof of the target of the head: it has no number
% of its own. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1 labels=a
% want subsec-1 proof - proves=thm-1
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{subsec}[thm]{}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{thm}\label{a} Every compact space is bounded. \end{thm}

\begin{subsec} {\bf Proof of Theorem \ref{a}.} Cover the space by finitely
many balls of radius one.
\end{subsec}
\end{document}
